ABSOLUTELY NO HAIR, ponytail, mane, white hair or skull-white face. She holds the complete ivory bone-clad Terminus sword with ornate skull-like hilt.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: Terminus sword; rhythm accuracy does not create an unsourced chorus spell. SOURCE ACTION: Enchaînement de Terminus. The Unknown attacks with the Terminus sword to the music. Fury is a real rhythm multiplier; the arena timing and numeric damage remain adapted rather than claiming an automatic16× gain.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct postures for the named ordinary source action: Entaille de Terminus sur le temps. Prepare, aim or wind up, real source action in THIRD pose, recover. Keep the exact fixed anatomy and tool. No unrelated power or missing equipment. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.

THIS IS A COMPLETE48-POSE IDENTITY CORRECTION: discard the mistaken identity details in the first attached prior atlas; it is only a guide to pixel style. The SECOND reference is the actual official header: its white/gray shoulder FUR is NOT HAIR. Remove ALL white hair behind the head in EVERY pose. Three yellow eyes remain on the bald red face. For all three attack groups, THIRD pose must show the whole Terminus blade forward SCREEN-RIGHT at WAIST HEIGHT, never pointed back behind the head. No flame sword.
